objective: Provide one provenance-bearing, nonreconstructive manuscript truth layer for entities, events, causal/goal relations, story/discourse time, character knowledge and downstream invalidation without forcing ambiguous narrative into invented certainty.

privacy_and_rights.source_anchor_representation: chapter/ordinal/token-range identifiers plus SHA-256 digest; downstream tools may resolve text only from an authorized live source

temporal_rules: Story-time relation and discourse-order relation are separate claims.
A flashback/flashforward is not a contradiction merely because discourse order differs from story-time order.
Repeated narration of one event may use SAME_STORY_EVENT while retaining multiple discourse anchors.
Ambiguous chronology must be represented as ALTERNATIVE or UNRESOLVED rather than normalized to one invented ordering.
Contradictory ASSERTED temporal claims fail validation unless at least one is INVALIDATED or both are explicitly represented as alternatives in a conflict group.
perspective_rules: FOCALIZES does not imply narrator identity or truth of a character belief.
Character knowledge claims must be provenance-bearing and temporally compatible with exposure when exposure evidence exists.
Intentional omniscience or perspective transgression may be represented; the state model is descriptive, not prescriptive.
invalidation_rules: When an anchor changes, all directly dependent claims become invalidation candidates.
Downstream derived artifacts must consume invalidation candidates before retaining authoritative standing.
Unrelated claims must not be invalidated merely because another manuscript span changed.
non_goals: inventing chronology to eliminate deliberate ambiguity
replacing human review where narrative interpretation is genuinely contested
